avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing phenytoin metabolism and reducing therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if patient requires St. John's Wort, monitor phenytoin levels closely and adjust dose

avoid_supplements.name: Folate (high-dose supplementation)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: High-dose folate may interfere with phenytoin metabolism and increase seizure risk; phenytoin depletes folate stores
avoid_supplements.action: Use only physiologic doses (400-800 mcg); supplement at recommended dietary allowance to prevent deficiency-related complications

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (taken simultaneously)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Calcium binds phenytoin in the GI tract, reducing absorption and therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2-3 hours; coordinate timing with patient and caregivers

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplementation
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenytoin increases vitamin D metabolism; supplementation may help prevent deficiency-related bone disease
caution_supplements.action: Monitor vitamin D levels; consider supplementation if deficient, but coordinate with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenytoin may impair vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; supplementation may partially mitigate this effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor coagulation parameters; discuss supplementation with prescriber if deficiency suspected

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenytoin may deplete magnesium; supplementation may improve seizure control in some patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor magnesium levels; consider supplementation if low, ensuring adequate spacing from phenytoin dose

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing phenytoin levels and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance of grapefruit and grapefruit juice

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase phenytoin absorption variability; phenytoin absorption is inconsistent and food-dependent
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal patterns; take phenytoin with consistent food intake to optimize absorption

caution_foods.name: Folic acid-rich foods (leafy greens)
caution_foods.mechanism: Phenytoin impairs folate metabolism; adequate dietary folate intake is beneficial for preventing deficiency
caution_foods.action: Encourage regular consumption of folate-rich foods (spinach, kale, legumes) to counteract phenytoin-induced depletion

monitoring_notes: Phenytoin has a narrow therapeutic window and highly variable metabolism; monitor serum levels regularly (therapeutic range 10-20 mcg/mL) and assess for signs of toxicity (ataxia, nystagmus, gingival hyperplasia). Coordinate all supplements with prescriber given phenytoin's extensive CYP450 interactions and known depletion of folate, vitamin D, and vitamin K.
